_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% base rate for ±2-point moves across 34 consecutive 12h windows is the strongest signal in this dataset — the coil is real, and forcing a directional call in a zero-movement regime is how records go 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst forward-calls Disbelief (UP) with medium conviction but self-contradicts on phase placement; narrative implies UP toward Hope but provides no explicit forward call. Neither brain presents evidence strong enough to override the 0% movement base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC funding drops below 0.003% with MVRV Z-score rising above 30 and stablecoin growth turning positive — genuine capital formation breaking the coil upward
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 75 with DXY strengthening above 101 and BTC funding flipping negative — coil breaks downward into Anxiety/Panic
